item.description: Kindness is making its way around Hartselle. Key Club students from across Alabama created “Kindness Rocks” for the Kiwanis clubs that support them. item.title: Kimbrell announces retirement from Hartselle Junior High - hartselleenquirer
item.description: Hartselle Junior High School Principal Tina Kimbrell announced her retirement during the March meeting of the Hartselle City Schools Board of Education. Kimbrell, who has served the system as both a teacher and principal, will complete the current school year before stepping down.
